track: Megan Thee Stallion, Beyoncé - Savage Remix (feat. Beyoncé)

sections.notes: Starting the mashup with a powerful, high-energy rap section from Megan, immediately setting an energetic, club-ready tone.
Transitioning back to Savage Remix with another high-energy, happy segment, likely Beyoncé's iconic verse, to re-energize the mix after the N95 interlude and build on the party vibe.
Bringing in the absolute highest energy section of Savage Remix as the powerful climax and memorable finale of the mashup, leaving the audience on a high note.

Introducing a stark contrast with Kendrick Lamar's intense and darker vocal delivery. This section provides a dynamic shift in mood and energy, offering a moment of serious intensity before returning to high energy.
A brief, impactful return to N95, serving as a short, suspenseful bridge or a distinct vocal interjection to add another layer of texture and anticipation before the final Savage Remix drop.
